name: card-grid
description: Optional eyebrow + headline above a row/grid of cards or icon tiles. Card style picks the tile look.

card_style.description: Look of the Card items (icon tiles always keep their own look).

spacing_top.description: Background-matched vertical space top the section (replaces the source's divider spacers): md = 96px, lg = 120px.

spacing_bottom.description: Background-matched vertical space bottom the section (replaces the source's divider spacers): md = 96px, lg = 120px.

view.name: CardGrid
view.notes: Contained 1380px (max 1920 container, 30px side padding), 24px gutters. Header row: eyebrow (mb 12) + h2 (fischer 48/58 600, max ~444px wide so it wraps to 2 lines; fischertechnik 42/52 600) then 72px gap to the cards. Icon-tile rows: 3 tiles 366px centered in 390px slots (not stretched). columns=4 -> 4-up (fischertechnik#2). Mobile: icon-tile rows become a horizontal swipe row (CSS scroll-snap; source carousel-fi is destroyed on desktop = static), other cards stack. category-tile (products overview): fixed 210px tiles, 5 per row (columns 5), gap 24, grid 1146 wide — fischer aligned to column 1 of the 1380 container, fischertechnik centered (theme preset); band padding 96/96 = spacing md/md on background panel. image-square (ft PDP teaser group): 3x 444 tiles, gap 24, no band padding.

styling_cues.card_border: borderless, radius 0; product-teaser hover shadow rgba(0,0,0,.1) 0 0 30px

view.responsive_notes: Source flags fischer#2 and fischertechnik#10 as carousel-fi--destroyed (static at desktop, slider only on mobile). Built static; mobile scroll-snap swipe is a CSS-only enhancement — no view.interaction.
